scope:
Package K2a (KERNEL DATA + SESSION, first third of M1-K2; no ChatEngine branch, no new actions, no web): the interview of the person ('Ty') gets Polish questions, a first question about HOW MUCH to ask (levels), and remarks that close topics. Source of truth: docs/architecture/M1_USTAWIENIA_JAKO_GRAF_2026-10-16.md section '### M1-K2' (line ~331; read only that item and section 3 'Ekrany' parts that mention Ty / wywiad / Poznajmy sie if you need the words) and docs/reports/INDEX.md 'S1 / M1-K1c4' last lines only for the repo state. Branch claude/m1-w0 is at b1b34f17 or later. The owner's rules that apply here: nothing is decided for the person (every limit is a configurable preset, the person chooses the level), nothing is asked twice after 'declined', 'never' is respected forever until the person reopens it, no private data leaves the machine from this package (it is local data + logic only), his lists are EXAMPLES (minimal/normal/detailed and the example remarks are seeds: fill them with what fits the categories that already exist in the scenario and say what you added).
EXISTING (checked): loom/data/onboarding/scenario.pack (298 lines, schema loom.onboarding.scenario/1, id onboarding.interview, method_ref.recipe_hash, fields[{id, section, category, detail, sensitivity, default_key?}], sections[{id, title (English string), questions[{field, text (English string)}]}]); loom/src/onboarding/profile.cpp (650 lines; ProfileSession::create(scenario, defaults, existing), dispatch/apply (ops incl. ask/store/declined/never, caps max_detail / max_sensitivity per request, model_request / ingest_model_reply), sync_graph); loom/include/loom/onboarding.h; generator loom/src/onboarding/gen_onboarding_pack.py (--check, recipe_hash, writes loom/src/onboarding/builtin.inc with EXPLICIT chunk lengths - keep that - and loom/web/src/onboarding/generated/*); tests loom/tests/test_onboarding*.cpp (hashes and texts); the settings 'profile_detail_level' and 'profile_detail_by_category' already exist as fields (loom/data/runtime/settings_fields.pack, chat_context.pack) - reuse them, do not add parallel settings.
BUILD, commit after each: (1) LOCALE: sections[].title and questions[].text become {en, pl} objects (all existing questions get a natural, plain Polish text in the owner's register: short, no jargon, no 'application'/'user' calls - 'Ty', second person; English text unchanged); ProfileSession gains questions(locale) that returns the text in the requested language (fallback en); a missing pl is a test failure, not a silent fallback. (2) LEVELS: a new first section 'detail' with ONE question (the person chooses how much the application may ask: {en,pl}) and scenario.detail_levels[{id: minimal|normal|detailed, label{pl,en}, preview{asks{pl,en}, stores{pl,en}, model_sees{pl,en}}, max_detail, max_sensitivity}] - the preview texts say in plain words what will be asked, what will be stored and what the model would see at that level, computed or at least consistent with the real counts of fields (a test checks the numbers named in the preview equal the real counts when the preview contains numbers). The number of questions asked = fields with detail <= level.max_detail and sensitivity <= level.max_sensitivity that are not known/declined/never (add the method e.g. ProfileSession::plan(level) returning the ordered list of fields to ask and the reason each skipped field is skipped). The chosen level is stored through the existing setting profile_detail_level (preset value, not a hard-coded constant), per category override through profile_detail_by_category. Defaults are presets: say in the card which level is the preset and why. (3) REMARKS: scenario.remark_rules[{pattern{pl[],en[]}, effect: {category, status:'never'} | {detail_level_delta: +1|-1}}] and ProfileSession::apply_remark(text, locale) -> {matched rule ids, effects applied} - e.g. 'nie pytaj o zdrowie' / 'do not ask about health' -> status never for that category; 'wystarczy' / 'enough' -> detail_level_delta -1; 'pytaj wiecej' / 'ask more' -> +1; seed rules for EVERY category present in the scenario (not only health) in both languages, matching case-insensitively on whole words/phrases with Polish diacritics folded (reuse the project's existing text-normalising helper if one exists - grep before writing a new one); no match = no effect (never guess); an effect is returned as a PROPOSAL the caller applies (the person must see 'Tak zrozumialem' later in W2) - apply_remark does not write fields by itself unless a flag says so; 'never' from a remark must reuse the existing never semantics of apply(). (4) GENERATOR + TESTS: update gen_onboarding_pack.py so the new structure is validated (schema checks for {en,pl}, levels, rules) and recipe_hash is recomputed; regenerate loom/src/onboarding/builtin.inc and loom/web/src/onboarding/generated/* (python3 loom/src/onboarding/gen_onboarding_pack.py, then --check clean); python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/clang_inc_check.py loom/build/dev must stay all ok; update loom/tests/test_onboarding*.cpp (hashes, PL texts) and add doctest cases: Polish and English questions; minimal asks fewer than detailed; declined/never respected on a second plan(); remark 'nie pytaj o zdrowie' -> never for the category; the model_request of a never field still denied; every category has a rule in both languages; preview numbers equal the real counts; test_abi_compat unchanged. If any web file under loom/web/src/onboarding/generated/ changes, run cd loom/web && npm run build and the unit tests that read the generated files (grep for 'onboarding/generated' in loom/web/tests). No new route literal expected; if you add one run the registry chain (gen_graph_interfaces.py -> gen_runtime_profiles.py (then --check) -> re-pin sha256 of graph/interfaces.pack in data_domains.pack -> ctest -R 'graph_entry|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|runtime_profile|onboarding_pack|graph_proj').
DECISIONS ARE YOURS (R1-R53): record each with how to reverse under 'S1 / M1-K2a' in docs/reports/INDEX.md. Do NOT touch loom/android/smoke/*, loom/src/chat/chat_engine.cpp, ops.cpp/actions.pack (that is K2b), the golden chat_request_legacy.json, or loom/web components. If after about 60 tool calls a piece is unfinished, commit what is consistent and return done=false with exactly what is left.
accept: cmake --build --preset dev (background, polled with short calls) succeeds; ctest --preset dev -R 'onboarding|profile|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|settings_fields|runtime_profile|abi_compat|compat' green; python3 loom/src/onboarding/gen_onboarding_pack.py --check clean; python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/clang_inc_check.py loom/build/dev all ok; python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/lint_asan_range_for.py b1b34f17 shows 0 suspicious lines; web unit tests that read generated onboarding files pass; pushed to origin claude/m1-w0. The card pastes: two questions in pl and en, the three level previews (pl), the plan() result for minimal vs detailed (counts and skipped reasons), the remark examples and their effects (pl and en), what you added beyond the owner's examples, the preset level and why, and exactly what is left.
rules_extra: Shared machine: never kill processes by name; record the pid/port you started. Do NOT run the full gate (S1 does). CACHE RULE: no single tool call longer than ~4 minutes - run builds and tests in the background and poll with short calls. One native build at a time (loom/build/dev of this worktree). Keep context small: grep and line ranges, never dump big files. ASAN pitfall: never range-for over .at()/.value()/operator[] of a by-value temporary - bind to a named const first. Generated *.inc data keeps explicit lengths (the generator already does). Tests must not depend on speed or order. Private data: synthetic data only; never read docs/exports or eval/real-holdout-key. Texts for the owner in plain Polish and English; nothing described as working that is only planned.
